mapper.sql: t.id, t.task_name, t.task_bean, t.task_params, t.task_cron, t.task_status, t.remark, t.update_time, t.create_time, t.task_type, t.exe_path, t.datasource_id, ds.name AS datasource_name, t.datasource_pool_id, dsp.name AS datasource_pool_name, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(d.pre_task_id ORDER BY d.pre_task_id SEPARATOR ',') FROM t_quartz_task_dependency d WHERE d.task_id = t.id AND d.dependency_type = 'DATA' ) AS depend_id, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(d.pre_task_id ORDER BY d.pre_task_id SEPARATOR ',') FROM t_quartz_task_dependency d WHERE d.task_id = t.id AND d.dependency_type = 'DATA' ) AS data_depend_id, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(d.pre_task_id ORDER BY d.pre_task_id SEPARATOR ',') FROM t_quartz_task_dependency d WHERE d.task_id = t.id AND d.dependency_type = 'CONTROL' ) AS control_depend_id, t.period, t.task_system, t.theme, t.offset, t.job_key, t.notification_failed, t.notification_completed
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_quartz_task t LEFT JOIN sys_datasource_config ds ON ds.id = t.datasource_id LEFT JOIN sys_datasource_pool dsp ON dsp.id = t.datasource_pool_id WHERE t.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM t_quartz_task t LEFT JOIN sys_datasource_config ds ON ds.id = t.datasource_id LEFT JOIN sys_datasource_pool dsp ON dsp.id = t.datasource_pool_id WHERE t.task_status = 0 ORDER BY t.id

SELECT FROM t_quartz_task t LEFT JOIN sys_datasource_config ds ON ds.id = t.datasource_id LEFT JOIN sys_datasource_pool dsp ON dsp.id = t.datasource_pool_id INNER JOIN t_quartz_task_dependency d ON d.task_id = t.id WHERE d.pre_task_id = #{id}
SELECT DISTINCT pre_task_id FROM t_quartz_task_dependency WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY pre_task_id

SELECT , ws.data_date AS dataDate FROM t_quartz_task_status ws INNER JOIN t_quartz_task t ON t.id = ws.plan_id LEFT JOIN sys_datasource_config ds ON ds.id = t.datasource_id LEFT JOIN sys_datasource_pool dsp ON dsp.id = t.datasource_pool_id WHERE ws.status = 1 AND t.task_status = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_quartz_task_status newer_ws WHERE newer_ws.plan_id = ws.plan_id AND newer_ws.data_date = ws.data_date AND ( COALESCE(newer_ws.update_time, newer_ws.create_time) > COALESCE(ws.update_time, ws.create_time) OR ( COALESCE(newer_ws.update_time, newer_ws.create_time) = COALESCE(ws.update_time, ws.create_time) AND newer_ws.id > ws.id ) ) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_quartz_task_dependency d WHERE d.task_id = ws.plan_id AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_quartz_task_status ds WHERE ds.plan_id = d.pre_task_id AND ds.data_date = ws.data_date AND ds.status = 3 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_quartz_task_status newer_ds WHERE newer_ds.plan_id = ds.plan_id AND newer_ds.data_date = ds.data_date AND ( COALESCE(newer_ds.update_time, newer_ds.create_time) > COALESCE(ds.update_time, ds.create_time) OR ( COALESCE(newer_ds.update_time, newer_ds.create_time) = COALESCE(ds.update_time, ds.create_time) AND newer_ds.id > ds.id ) ) ) ) ) ORDER BY ws.id
